question: Fiscal-year-matched Fidelity Charitable grant count: Fidelity's 990 year ends 30 June but its Giving Reports publish calendar-year counts (2,340,165 in CY2023; 2,664,446 in CY2024); look for a stated FY (Jul 2023-Jun 2024) count in the 990 Schedule O or audited statements, otherwise document the CY2023/CY2024 mean (2,502,306) as a derived value
